text:
All 7 requirements have been implemented and verified:

- **[R1]** Immutability enforced via `__slots__` and read-only properties — assignment raises `AttributeError`.
- **[R2]** Iteration support via `__iter__` yielding major, minor, patch, prerelease, build in order.
- **[R3]** All comparison operators (`__eq__`, `__ne__`, `__lt__`, `__le__`, `__gt__`, `__ge__`) handle tuples correctly; strings raise `TypeError`; integers return `False`.
- **[R4]** `bump_major`, `bump_minor`, `bump_patch`, `bump_prerelease`, `bump_build` each return a new `VersionInfo` instance with the correct component incremented.
- **[R5]** Constructor converts `major`/`minor`/`patch` to `int`, `prerelease`/`build` to `str`.
- **[R6]** Module exposes `createparser()`, `main()`, and `process()` for the `pysemver` CLI.
- **[R7]** Module-level `replace()` function and `VersionInfo.replace()` method both work correctly.

All 106 existing tests pass. `STATUS.json` has been written at the repository root.
